## Purpose

What problem does this change solve for a student, instructor, or maintainer?

## Changes

Summarize the affected files and any change in application behavior.

## Validation

Record commands run and manual checks performed. Explicitly identify checks not run.

## Deployment and rollback

Does this affect generated output, hosting, storage, or configuration? Identify the prior working commit or deployment. Do not merge or deploy until the maintainer approves.

## Checklist

- [ ] Examples and screenshots contain no personal information or secrets.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Existing lockfiles, license terms, and attribution are preserved unless an approved change requires otherwise.
